title: Antigravity IDE Brain Workspace Epistemic Topology and Scratch Salvage Invariants
author: Antigravity Book-to-Skill Forge (book-to-skill-forge)
context: The Antigravity IDE maintains a primary filesystem-native workspace store at C:\Users\spectre\.gemini\antigravity-ide\brain\ spanning 343 conversation directories, 1,085 Python scratch tools, 530 strategic plans/walkthroughs, 1,655 subprocess task logs, and 243 dual-transcript streams. While conversations/*.db contains relational execution telemetry, the brain/ store constitutes the living epistemic workspace of the developer-agent partnership.
distilled_learning: # Antigravity IDE Brain Workspace Epistemic Topology and Scratch Salvage Invariants

claims.assertion: The Antigravity IDE brain/ store contains a massive reservoir of 1,085 domain-specialized Python scratch tools across 343 conversation workspaces that can be classified via AST inspection into seven cohesive functional categories.

Dual-transcript stream architectures feature paired compact (transcript.jsonl) and untruncated (transcript_full.jsonl) files where compact steps with is_truncated: true must be dereferenced by step_index to prevent reasoning loss.

Background subprocess tasks in .system_generated/tasks/task-*.log (1,655 files) record exit codes and pipe deadlocks that require bounded ring-buffer stderr drainage to prevent silent failure masking.
